theses.author: Forward Thesis Quant
theses.title: NVDA Post-Earnings Drift Continuation
theses.thesis: NVDA showing textbook post-earnings announcement drift pattern. Strong beat followed by 3-day consolidation near highs suggests institutional accumulation before next leg higher.
support_statements: Historical PEAD studies show 60%+ win rate for drift continuation after 2%+ beat on both revenue and EPS
Dark pool prints consistently hitting at ask price during consolidation — suggests buyers absorbing supply
Options flow shows aggressive call buying in 2-week expiry, dealers likely short gamma
AI capex cycle commentary from management exceeded Street expectations
What would make us wrong: Break below $118 consolidation low invalidates accumulation thesis

theses.author: Edge Lab Quant
theses.title: SPY Gamma Scalp — Dealer Positioning Play
theses.thesis: Dealer gamma positioning flipped short after yesterday's rally. This creates conditions for amplified moves in either direction. We position for mean reversion with tight stops.
support_statements: GEX flipped negative for first time in 8 sessions — historically leads to 1.5x intraday range expansion
0DTE put volume spiked 40% suggesting retail hedging creates pin risk at round numbers
VIX term structure normalized post-FOMC — reduces tail risk on short gamma exposure
What would make us wrong: Sustained move above SPY 458 on volume invalidates mean reversion setup

theses.title: Sector Rotation Signal — Watching Only
theses.thesis: Our factor model detects early rotation signal from growth to value. Not actionable today but worth monitoring for potential XLF long if signal strengthens.
support_statements: Growth/value ratio broke 20-day moving average for first time since July
Bank earnings next week could catalyze value rotation if NIM outlook improves
Signal strength at 0.6 vs our 0.75 threshold for action — watching not acting
Historical backtest shows 2-3 day lead time before optimal entry on rotation trades
